title.en: Let the machine turn the knobs

brief.zh: 在<level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref>里，你用一个、两个旋钮下过山。这次是一个未知的 3×3 核：九个旋钮，数字很乱，凭眼睛猜不出来。接上可学习核，按「训练」。
brief.en: In <level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref> you walked downhill with one knob, then two. This time it is an unknown 3×3 kernel: nine knobs with messy numbers you can't guess by eye. Wire up a learnable kernel and press "Train".

hint.zh: 每按一次，九个旋钮一起往下坡挪一步（和<level-ref to="4-1"></level-ref>、<level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref>一样，只是旋钮多了）。看损失曲线往下走。
hint.en: Each press moves all nine knobs one step downhill together (just as in <level-ref to="4-1"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref>, only with more knobs). Watch the loss curve go down.

after.zh: 你没有设计这个核，它是从例子里学出来的。手工设计的特征，就这样被学到的特征取代了。
after.en: You didn't design this kernel; it was learned from examples. This is how learned features replace hand-designed ones.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>里，你看着输入和输出，一格格拧出了一个 3×3 核。那个核的数字很整齐，猜得出来。要是九个数乱七八糟、毫无规律呢？
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> you looked at the input and output and worked out a 3×3 kernel cell by cell. Its numbers were tidy enough to guess. What if the nine numbers are a jumble with no pattern at all?

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:learn3"></part-ref>：和 3×3 核一样拿九个权重去压图，只是权重不用你填，它会照着测试的期望自己调。<level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref>只有一两个旋钮，这次是九个。
t.en: The new part is <part-ref to="part:learn3"></part-ref>: like the 3×3 kernel, it presses nine weights over the image, but you do not fill in the weights; it tunes them itself to match the tests' expected outputs. <level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref> had one or two knobs; this time there are nine.

t.zh: 这一关的输入是一片随机噪点，期望是某个没人告诉你的核压过它的结果。你要做的：让输出和期望对上。
t.en: The input in this level is random noise, and the expected output is what you get by pressing some kernel nobody tells you about over it. Your task: make the output match the expected.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：噪点 → 某个未知的核压过之后
caption.en: Set 1: noise → after an unknown kernel is pressed over it
